# sendio_templates (Data Source)

Lists the team's templates, newest first (every page).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sendio_templates" "all" {}

output "published_templates" {
  value = [for t in data.sendio_templates.all.templates : t.alias if t.status == "published"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `templates` (Attributes List) The templates. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--templates))

<a id="nestedatt--templates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `templates`

Read-Only:

- `alias` (String) Template alias.
- `created_at` (String) When the template was created.
- `current_version_id` (String) Id of the current version.
- `has_unpublished_versions` (Boolean) Whether a newer draft exists.
- `id` (String) Template id.
- `name` (String) Template name.
- `published_at` (String) When it was last published.
- `status` (String) `draft` or `published`.
- `updated_at` (String) When it was last changed.
